title: GRP: Goal-Reversed Prompting for Zero-Shot Evaluation with LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on a prompting methodology (Goal-Reversed Prompting) for the zero-shot evaluation of Large Language Models. It evaluates performance on technical tasks such as knowledge, reasoning, math, and coding using the JudgeBench dataset. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
